repairs.before: Narrow leading border fragments were excluded; labels and descriptions read out of row order
repairs.after: Fragmented borders connected; rowspans use local cell borders; labels precede descriptions

repairs.before: An accented row-leading p was stripped as a repeating symbol-font list marker
repairs.after: Math accent overlap and absent bullet spacing retain the original glyph

repairs.before: A short list question became part of the preceding/following answer formula region
repairs.after: Question remains translatable text; independent answer equations retain original regions

repairs.before: U+00AD at a line end was not joined and could disrupt word searches
repairs.after: Canonical source joins soft-hyphenated lines; reading text strips discretionary soft hyphens without changing original source geometry

repairs.before: Private-use symbol-font bullets were mistaken for a separate math column and list records merged
repairs.after: Same-baseline explicit bullet columns are reassociated; four original records each retain a canonical bullet

repairs.before: The preserved table was placed after its linked translated cell annotations because region regrouping ignored existing linked indexes; source block arrays could also disagree with explicit readingOrder
repairs.after: Stable explicit reading order drives initial placement; regrouping includes existing linked indexes as anchors. Reversed source-array and same-order stability cases protect ordering.

repairs.before: The existing row-spanning cell phrase split into System and group when only its baselines changed from 220/232 to 194/206 across the other columns horizontal rule at y=200
repairs.after: Same-cell evidence overrides row heuristics only when a horizontal boundary in another column lies strictly inside the candidate physical cell. Header rules coinciding with the body cell top edge do not establish a rowspan.
repairs.regressionTest: stitches fragmented Word grid borders and keeps rowspan labels whole with first baseline 194
repairs.verification: 277 tests passed, 2 conditional skips, four-core four-dimensional coverage 100%; all selected 70 public source pages re-audited successfully

repairs.before: A table with only outer horizontal borders and three vertical rules merged three description/numeric records into two blocks, mistaking whole columns for known row-spanning cells
repairs.after: Top/bottom borders and a header rule alone cannot override numerical record baselines. Both open fixtures retain six blocks; scientific numerical values remain separate. Alphanumeric SE labels remain multiline in real grid cells. Both original rowspan placements and a right-column mirror retain System group.
repairs.regressionTest: keeps numerical records separate in an open table with header rule true and values [1,2,3]

repairs.before: Adding only the header border y=115 caused the open three-record numeric table to collapse from six blocks to two because a global row-edge count treated the header as body-span evidence.
repairs.after: Span evidence must be an actual other-column horizontal border strictly inside the candidate cell bounds; the header is that body cell top boundary and is excluded. Numeric row evidence rejects alphanumeric labels such as SE 3.5 while accepting scientific notation.
repairs.verification: Header/no-header open tables, scientific notation, multiline alphanumeric label, left/right rowspan fixtures, strict coverage, and all selected 70 public pages pass.

limits: NASA original pages outside 14–31 (338 pages) and OpenStax outside 17–35 (979 pages) have not been audited here
The 70-page check demonstrates selected raw glyph and source-block representation, explicit order anchors and exact source identity; it is not complete semantic or visual acceptance
Original source screenshots and geometry overlays are QA evidence; they do not replace production browser and exported-file review
Search/copy, supplier translation, cancellation/retry, editable-history persistence and UI accessibility are owned by the parent integration checks
Sequential Node audit RSS is sampled at page boundaries and includes PDF.js/Vite plus previous documents; it is not browser peak-memory acceptance
The public 70-page selection contains no U+00AD; discretionary soft-hyphen behavior is verified using a controlled geometry fixture

controlledTranslationPlacement.scope: Fixed placeholder strings only; no supplier or semantic acceptance
